indication: Previously treated advanced/metastatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement
intervention: Pemigatinib 13.5 mg PO once daily, 2 weeks on / 1 week off
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility turns on a confirmed FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement, which this case has not yet tested (ngs_pending) — that single open axis caps the fit at partial. Tumor type, metastatic stage, and 2L+ setting all line up with the patient as framed. A positive RNA-based fusion read on the rank-1 CGP panel would move this to strong and open the FDA-approved on-label option.
intervention_dosing: 13.5 mg PO daily, 21-day cycle (2 on / 1 off)

indication: Previously treated advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement
inclusion_match_notes: Enrollment required a centrally confirmed FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in intrahepatic CCA; the patient's subsite is not specified at intake and the fusion is untested, so two axes are unresolved and fit stays partial. Futibatinib is an irreversible FGFR1-4 inhibitor with activity against some pemigatinib-resistance kinase-domain mutations, which matters for sequencing if FGFR therapy is later used. The CGP fusion call gates this option.

indication: Advanced cholangiocarcinoma with activating FGFR2 alterations
biomarker: Activating FGFR2 gene alteration (incl. acquired resistance mutations)
endpoint: Safety, tolerability, recommended phase 2 dose; antitumor activity
inclusion_match_notes: Open to advanced CCA with an activating FGFR2 alteration, including the kinase-domain resistance mutations that emerge on first-generation FGFR inhibitors — relevant if the patient turns out FGFR2-positive and later progresses on pemigatinib or futibatinib. Fit is partial because the FGFR2 status is untested and this is a phase 1 with no efficacy data yet. Recruiting now.

indication: Previously treated advanced cholangiocarcinoma, IDH1 R132-mutant
inclusion_match_notes: ClarIDHy enrolled IDH1 R132-mutant CCA after one to two prior regimens; the patient's tumor type and line match the design, but the IDH1 hotspot is untested so fit is partial. The HR for PFS was 0.37 versus placebo, with the median benefit blunted by short absolute PFS and heavy crossover affecting the OS read. A confirmed R132 mutation on the CGP DNA panel opens on-label ivosidenib.

indication: Previously treated HER2-amplified biliary tract cancer
endpoint: Confirmed objective response rate (independent central review)
inclusion_match_notes: Cohort 1 required HER2 amplification by ISH plus IHC 2+/3+ scored on the 4B5 companion antibody — an IHC/ISH readout, not an NGS copy-number call, so the gating test here is HER2 IHC with reflex ISH rather than the DNA panel alone. The patient's HER2 status is untested, holding fit at partial. HER2 is more common in extrahepatic/gallbladder disease, and subsite is unspecified at intake.

indication: HER2-expressing solid tumors incl. biliary tract cancer cohort
design: Open-label, multicohort phase 2 basket (DESTINY-PanTumor02), biliary tract cohort
intervention: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks
endpoint: Objective response rate, biliary tract cohort (investigator)
inclusion_match_notes: This is a biomarker-defined pan-tumor basket that accepts biliary tract cancer through a HER2-expressing cohort, so the patient could enroll on a positive HER2 IHC — the basket eligibility, not a CCA-specific protocol, is what admits them. The IHC 3+ subgroup responded at 56% versus 22% overall, so the exact IHC score drives expected benefit and the agent choice. T-DXd carries interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis risk that the treating team should weigh; no toxicity veto was set in preferences.

indication: First-line advanced HER2-expressing biliary tract cancer
design: Randomized phase 3, T-DXd + rilvegostomig vs standard of care
inclusion_match_notes: First-line HER2-expressing biliary tract cancer randomizing T-DXd plus a PD-1/TIGIT bispecific against gem/cis/durvalumab; entry needs a HER2 IHC readout the patient does not yet have. If HER2 tests positive and the patient is treatment-naive, this is one of the few targeted first-line CCA options. Fit is partial pending HER2 IHC and confirmation that no prior systemic therapy has been given.

indication: First-line advanced HER2-positive biliary tract cancer
design: Randomized phase 3, zanidatamab + chemo +/- checkpoint vs chemo
inclusion_match_notes: Moves zanidatamab into the first-line HER2-positive CCA setting alongside chemotherapy, building on the second-line HERIZON-BTC-01 signal. Enrollment needs HER2 positivity by IHC/ISH and a treatment-naive patient, neither confirmed here, so fit is partial. Relevant only if HER2 tests positive and the patient has had no prior systemic therapy.

indication: BRAF V600E-mutated biliary tract cancer cohort
design: Open-label, single-arm phase 2 basket, biliary cohort (ROAR)
intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg PO BID + trametinib 2 mg PO once daily
inclusion_match_notes: The ROAR biliary cohort enrolled molecularly confirmed BRAF V600E; a VE1 IHC screen is suggestive but not sufficient, so confirmation by NGS or PCR is the gate and non-V600E class-2/3 BRAF alterations do not qualify. The dabrafenib + trametinib combination also holds a tumor-agnostic BRAF V600E label, so the patient could be treated either through this CCA precedent or the agnostic approval. Untested status holds fit at partial.
intervention_dosing: dabrafenib 150 mg BID + trametinib 2 mg daily

indication: MSI-H/dMMR advanced noncolorectal solid tumors (incl. biliary)
inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic basket that admits MSI-H/dMMR biliary tract cancer on the biomarker alone, so the patient enrolls via the MSI/MMR criterion rather than a CCA-specific arm. MSI-H/dMMR is uncommon in biliary tract cancer (roughly 1-3%), so MMR IHC plus reflex MSI-PCR is the gate and a confirmed positive is decision-changing. Untested status holds fit at partial.

indication: TMB-high advanced solid tumors (>=10 mut/Mb), incl. biliary
endpoint: Objective response rate in tTMB-high subgroup
inclusion_match_notes: The tumor-agnostic TMB-high label keys off a validated NGS panel reporting >=10 mutations/Mb, so the patient would qualify only if the CGP returns a TMB-high result. The basket accepted biliary tract cancer through the biomarker, not a dedicated cohort. Untested TMB holds fit at partial; the same CGP that resolves the other axes returns this value.

indication: NTRK fusion-positive advanced solid tumors (integrated basket)
design: Integrated analysis of three phase 1-2 trials (ALKA-372-001, STARTRK-1, STARTRK-2)
inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic NTRK-fusion basket; a biliary patient would enroll on a confirmed NTRK1/2/3 fusion regardless of subsite. NTRK fusions are rare in CCA (<1%), best detected by RNA-based fusion NGS, which is the gate and which the rank-1 paired panel covers. Untested fusion status holds fit at partial.

indication: TRK fusion-positive advanced solid tumors (pooled basket)
design: Pooled analysis of three phase 1/2 trials (NAVIGATE and others)
inclusion_match_notes: Highly selective TRK inhibitor with a tumor-agnostic label; the patient enrolls or is treated on a confirmed NTRK fusion irrespective of CCA subsite. Same rare-fusion gate as entrectinib, resolved by the RNA arm of the rank-1 CGP. Untested status holds fit at partial.

indication: RET fusion-positive solid tumors other than lung/thyroid (basket)
inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic RET-fusion basket explicitly covering non-lung/non-thyroid solid tumors, so a biliary patient enrolls on a confirmed RET fusion. RET fusions are rare in CCA and need RNA-based fusion NGS, the gate covered by the rank-1 panel. Untested status holds fit at partial.

indication: KRAS G12C-mutated advanced solid tumors incl. biliary tract
inclusion_match_notes: KRAS G12C covalent inhibitors are tested in tumor-agnostic baskets that accept biliary tract cancer on the G12C mutation; the patient enrolls via the biomarker, not a CCA arm. KRAS G12C is uncommon in CCA, and the codon is captured by the rank-1 DNA panel. Untested status holds fit at partial; broader KRAS variants (G12D/G12V) would not qualify for a G12C inhibitor.

indication: Unresectable/metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement
inclusion_match_notes: Entry needs a centrally confirmed FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in intrahepatic CCA after at least one prior chemotherapy line, so tumor type and setting line up but the untested fusion holds fit at partial. Gunagratinib binds FGFR1-4 covalently, the same axis as pemigatinib and futibatinib, and could matter for sequencing if the patient tests FGFR2-positive. The rank-1 fusion panel is the gate.

indication: Advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement/mutation
inclusion_match_notes: The FGFR2-altered ICC cohort admits fusions, rearrangements, and activating mutations after prior systemic therapy, which widens the qualifying alteration set beyond fusion-only trials. Fit is partial because the patient's FGFR2 status is untested. Fanregratinib is a China-registration FGFR1-3 inhibitor, so US access would depend on trial-site geography.

indication: Previously treated cholangiocarcinoma, FGF/FGFR gene alteration
inclusion_match_notes: Cholangiocarcinoma with an FGF/FGFR alteration after prior systemic therapy qualifies, and the alteration criterion is broader than fusion-only. 3D185 pairs FGFR1-3 blockade with CSF-1R inhibition aimed at tumor-associated macrophages, a mechanism distinct from the approved FGFR inhibitors. Untested FGFR status and pre-recruitment posting hold fit at partial.

indication: Advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement/mutation, post 1L
design: Randomized, open-label phase 3, tinengotinib vs chemotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: Randomizes FGFR2-altered ICC that has progressed on one prior chemo-plus-immunotherapy line against chemotherapy, so tumor type and line match but the untested FGFR2 status caps fit at partial. Tinengotinib is a multikinase inhibitor with activity reported against FGFR kinase-domain resistance mutations that limit first-generation agents, which bears on sequencing after pemigatinib or futibatinib. Not yet recruiting, so timing is a further constraint.

indication: Non-CCA solid tumors with FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement
inclusion_match_notes: This basket explicitly excludes cholangiocarcinoma, enrolling FGFR2-fusion solid tumors of other types, so the patient cannot enroll and the row is informational only. It anchors the FGFR2-selective mechanism the patient's candidate feature would target, showing a less kinase-promiscuous inhibitor being tested off the CCA-heavy FGFR literature. Included for the cross-tumor precedent, not as an enrollment option.

indication: IDH1 R132-mutant malignancies (incl. cholangiocarcinoma)
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility requires a confirmed IDH1 R132 mutation and admits cholangiocarcinoma among IDH1-mutant malignancies, so the mechanism axis matches the patient's candidate IDH1 feature. This is a drug-interaction pharmacology study rather than an efficacy trial, and the IDH1 status is untested, so fit is weak. Its value is surfacing olutasidenib as a second mutant-IDH1 inhibitor beyond ivosidenib on the same actionable axis.

indication: Advanced HER2-expressing epithelial solid tumors
design: First-in-human, open-label phase 1 dose escalation (+/- nivolumab)
inclusion_match_notes: The basket admits any HER2-expressing epithelial cancer, so a HER2-positive biliary patient could enroll on the biomarker rather than a CCA-specific arm. MT-304 is a HER2-directed T-cell engager, a modality distinct from the HER2 antibodies and ADCs already in the dossier, which broadens the HER2 mechanism options if the patient tests positive. Untested HER2 and phase 1 status hold fit at partial.

indication: HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (dedicated cohort) and other solid tumors
design: First-in-human, open-label phase 1/2 with a HER2-positive biliary tract cancer expansion cohort
intervention: Nesfrotamig (YH32367 / ABL105), HER2 x 4-1BB bispecific antibody
endpoint: Safety, recommended phase 2 dose; objective response rate (expansion)
inclusion_match_notes: A dedicated HER2-positive biliary tract cancer expansion cohort makes this a direct tumor-type match, gated on pathology-confirmed HER2 positivity the patient has not yet obtained. Nesfrotamig localizes 4-1BB costimulation to HER2-expressing tumor cells, a T-cell-engaging mechanism separate from the HER2 ADCs and bispecifics already captured. Untested HER2 status holds fit at partial; early phase 1 responses in HER2-positive CCA have been reported.

indication: HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (dedicated cohort) and colorectal cancer
intervention: KN026, HER2 biparatopic bispecific antibody (+/- KN046 PD-L1/CTLA-4 bispecific)
inclusion_match_notes: A HER2-positive biliary tract cancer cohort sits alongside the colorectal cohort, so a HER2-positive biliary patient could enroll on the biomarker. KN026 binds two non-overlapping HER2 epitopes, similar in class to zanidatamab but a separate program, and pairs with the KN046 dual checkpoint bispecific. HER2 status is untested and the study is not yet recruiting, holding fit at partial.
sponsor: Peking University Cancer Hospital / Alphamab Oncology

indication: HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (intrahepatic/extrahepatic CCA, gallbladder)

intervention: EB-HC01, allogeneic HER2/CEACAM5 dual-target CAR-NK cells (with fludarabine/cyclophosphamide lymphodepletion)
inclusion_match_notes: Enrollment covers intrahepatic, extrahepatic, and gallbladder biliary cancer after prior gemcitabine/platinum, requiring central confirmation of both HER2 positivity and CEACAM5 expression, so it needs a dual-marker readout the patient does not have. EB-HC01 is an allogeneic HER2/CEA CAR-NK product, a cell-therapy route on the HER2 required-antigen axis not otherwise represented. Prior HER2-targeted therapy and durvalumab are allowed, which suits sequencing; untested biomarkers hold fit at partial.

indication: HER2-positive/HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors
intervention: Trastuzumab pamirtecan (DB-1303 / BNT323), HER2 ADC (TOP1-inhibitor payload)
endpoint: Safety, recommended dose; objective response rate
inclusion_match_notes: HER2-positive or HER2-expressing solid tumors qualify across cohorts, so a HER2-positive biliary patient enrolls on the biomarker rather than a CCA arm. Trastuzumab pamirtecan is a topoisomerase-1-payload HER2 ADC in the same class as trastuzumab deruxtecan, which matters because ADC payload class shapes the interstitial-lung-disease watch. Untested HER2 status holds fit at partial.

indication: HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors incl. biliary tract cancer

A HER2-low (IHC 1+) result would be a softer eligibility and efficacy signal than IHC 3+, so a low-positive match here is a weaker fit than the amplified case. Untested HER2 status holds fit at partial.

indication: HER2-expressing biliary tract cancer (ICC/ECC/gallbladder)

Disitamab vedotin carries an MMAE payload, so the regimen adds a peripheral-neuropathy watch that the antibody and TOP1-ADC options do not; no toxicity veto was set in preferences. Untested HER2 and pre-recruitment status hold fit at partial.

sponsor: Peking Union Medical College Hospital / RemeGen

indication: HER2-positive (IHC 3+) advanced solid tumors incl. gallbladder cancer

T-DXd carries interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis risk to weigh; untested HER2 holds fit at partial.

indication: Advanced solid tumors harboring NTRK gene fusion
inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic NTRK-fusion basket open to advanced solid tumors, so a biliary patient enrolls on a confirmed fusion regardless of subsite. Zurletrectinib is a next-generation TRK inhibitor with reported activity against on-target resistance mutations that emerge on larotrectinib or entrectinib, relevant if the patient is NTRK-positive and later progresses. NTRK fusions are rare in CCA and untested here, holding fit at partial.
